svg.title: Decorative Pac-Man public event grid
svg.desc: A decorative Pac-Man sits on a contribution-style grid that summarizes only recent sampled public PushEvents, not a full contribution calendar.
svg.text: Static fallback: decorative grid, with cells based only on the latest sampled public PushEvents.
The character is decorative. This is not GitHub’s full daily contribution calendar or a claim about private activity.
